notes: The catalog text does not contain a section for the Gerontology: Geriatric Health Care Certificate of Achievement. It prints the A.A. in Gerontology: Geriatric Health Care (pp. 634-635), the A.A. in Gerontology: Recreation, then under 'Certificates of Achievement' the Gerontology: Administrative Certificate and the Gerontology: Advocacy and Social Policy Certificate, which is cut off mid-table on page 637. The Geriatric Health Care certificate presumably appears on a later page not included.

The A.A. in Gerontology: Geriatric Health Care section lists, for 36 total units: COMM C1004; COMM 325 or SWCD 330 or PSYC 365; GERON 303; GERON 305 or PSYC 375; GERON 306; GERON 490; SWCD 300; SWCD 310; a minimum of 3 units of GERON 498 (0.5-4); and a minimum of 9 units from AH 311, BIOL 304 or BIOL 300 or NURSE 100, NUTRI 324, SLPA 126. The certificate likely mirrors this (as the Administrative certificate mirrors its degree), but that was not recorded because the certificate's own section is absent. A reviewer should obtain the certificate page and re-extract.
The catalog uses SWCD 300/310/330 where the closed list has HSER 300/310/330 and COMM C1004 where the closed list has COMM 321, apparently renumbered courses.
